text:
Happy are you who, cheerful in your hut,
young and old breathed the pure breeze,
and are served as cradle and grave
by a roof of straw and a floor of reeds.


In that solitude, freely bathed
by a silent sun in safer light,
life lasts longer within the day,
and the voiceless hour disillusions you.


You do not count years by consuls;
your harvests make your calendar;
you tread your whole world without deceit.


All you do not know benefits you;
you neither crave rewards nor suffer harm,
and grow broader the more you are confined.

translation.title: A un amigo que retirado de la Corte pasó su edad
